text: {"behavior": "ANSWER", "answer": "If there is no loan, you need Form 29 (Notice of Transfer of Ownership) and Form 30 (Application for Intimation and Transfer of Ownership). These forms are required for the transfer of ownership in a normal sale. Additionally, you will need the following documents: original Registration Certificate (RC), valid insurance certificate, Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate, PAN card of both the seller and buyer, address proof of the buyer, and the prescribed fee.
